title: The Progression of Blood (5): Yom Kippur — one substitute covers a nation
summary: Fifth step in “The Progression of Blood”: Yom Kippur, the Day of Atonement, where one substitute sacrifice covers the entire nation. Leviticus 16:15 is quoted, with “goat” and “blood” highlighted in red: the goat's blood is sprinkled on the mercy seat.

text.text: One Substitute Sacrifice Covers Entire Nation

15 “Then he shall slaughter the goat of the sin offering which is for the people, and bring its blood inside the veil and do with its blood as he did with the blood of the bull, and sprinkle it on the mercy seat and in front of the mercy seat.”

uncertain: The Hebrew reference is written ויקרא יו:יה (16 as yod-vav, 15 as yod-he) rather than the usual טז:טו; transcribed as shown.
